attributes.long_name: GEDI RH98, cell median of night shots only
attributes.definition: GEDI L2A V003 rh: 'Relative height metrics at 1 % interval' (GEDI L2A V3 product data dictionary); RH100 = elev_highestreturn - elev_lowestmode (GEDI L2 User Guide V2.1). rh98 is the height above the lowest mode at which 98 % of the returned waveform energy is reached.
